svg.title: Figure 8. Process Flow of the Manual Transaction
svg.desc: This shows the paper-based visit described in the manuscript. A health professional decides whether a child should receive a vaccine.

g.text: FIGURE 8. PROCESS FLOW OF THE MANUAL TRANSACTION
Based on the paper; health-center confirmation still needed
Find or create the paper record
Write down the dose and date
Tell the guardian the next step
